name: Ribas de Campos (Spain)
description: Square flag horizontally divided red over green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ribas de Campos (a tower on white above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Ribas de Campos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Ribas de Campos arms — tower on white above waves
tower and crown of the arms
